request.text:
A: He means the town chest, not my till. Still. Done.
<long pause>
A: Mine's the only warm hearth left on the street since you took it. Folk keep crowding in. I tell them it's the stew.
<long pause>
A: <practical, warm, quick but clear Mood: idle.> Bree's old shard is the only warm hearth on the street now. Funny how that's starting to matter.
<long pause>
B: Light it… someone said that. I said that, I think. Let them be warm. Is a memory worth more than a child who isn't hungry?
<long pause>
B: The circle is open. Bring your embers here and help me finish it!
<long pause>
B: The dragon came after the Fall for this heat. Now it wakes. Guard the hearth!
